doc: Story positions and conditions as data. Positions are game metres (Y up, X along rue Pasteur, Z south); yaw in degrees, 0 faces +Z. Level markers (assets/levels/campus.glb) win unless an entry sets "override": true. Check new points with autotest=place. "sits" (the sit-downs, V2-14: pos and yaw of the seat; cams a, b, c as {from, look, fov} or {rel: [deg from his facing, metres, height], look_h, fov}; move {orbit deg/s | drift [x,y,z] m/s}; music a data/songs.json stem or "@flag"), "finder_places" (the finder app's last-seen pins), spots with a `note` (a sticky note drawn there). "lights": the story's own lights (one unshadowed omni light each, on while `when` holds and the preset is in `times`; `bulbs` [from, to] strung with `count` beads). "cam_occluders": boxes {pos, size, yaw in degrees} that only the camera checks see (LevelBinder.CAMERA_OCCLUDERS), for level meshes with no collider that a conversation or sit camera must not film through (a door leaf standing open). A shot may be relative to Mano ({"on": "mano", rel, look_h, look_rel, fov}, as a sit camera); points for chapters 0, 4 and 5 (the kebab meeting, the sound search, '1, 2, 3, ACU!', the seats on the steps, the post-credits on rue Pasteur). "ducks" (the twelve golden ducks, V2-30: chapter, the duck whisperer's hint, and a pos for the four that have no level marker, snapped to the floor; glow for the two night ones), "photos" (Ishita's film: ten spots, pos where the photographer stands, look what is framed, range metres, tol degrees, chapter, when, a thought when first near), "overheard" (V2-31: two staged NPCs a and b, a cue, radius, when) and about seventy more look-at spots with a kind (look, read, listen, grab); a read spot's `insert` {look, from?, fov?} is a 20° insert on what is read.
